title: When Language Models Misinterpret Uncertainty in Earth System Mechanism Attribution
summary: Mechanistic attribution in Earth system science requires quantifying uncertainty and communicating its implications. Here, we develop an uncertainty-aware mechanistic attribution pipeline that constructs probabilistic fingerprints from ensemble estimates, including covariance-aware separation of competing mechanisms, and an evidence ladder that systematically varies the information provided to language models (LLMs). We evaluate this framework in an idealized stochastic system and a coupled El Niño model using controlled interventions and ensemble data assimilation. In the idealized system,…
